about: Built-in Ordo: the Lectionary citations for each liturgical day (Roman Missal, Lectionary for Mass, with the Philippine calendar: Epiphany, Ascension and Corpus Christi on Sundays, the Santo Nino on the third Sunday of January). Citations only, never reading texts. Compiled for APCCMMA; proofread against the year's CBCP Ordo before relying on it. r1 First Reading, ps Responsorial Psalm, r2 Second Reading, acc Gospel Acclamation verse, gos Gospel. A/B/C override for the Sunday cycle, I/II for the weekday cycle. Day codes are worked out in shared/liturgical-day.js.
